verdict.rationale: USPTO has some machine access. Patent Center documents users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications, and api.uspto.gov answers unauthenticated requests with a structured auth challenge, which points to a key-based API that a headless job could call. That evidence only covers application viewing, though, and the core filing flows require an MFA-verified USPTO.gov account. Missing for 10: documented headless or CI usage, a CLI or service-account auth for automation, programmatic filing and payment, readable API docs (the developer portal is a JS app shell and no OpenAPI spec was found), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: For users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications, this update required a change to the version level of the APIs within Workbench/view applications.
